wstep: There is no recipe here for pork belly cooked in a broth of onion skins (Polish boczek gotowany w łupinach cebuli).

ostrzezenia.tekst: UGA recommends cooking products made from ground pork and beef to an internal temperature of 160 °F.
According to ANSES, the French food safety agency, keeping the cold chain is essential for foods that are cooked but not sterilized, such as pâté and ready meals.

akapity: The UGA rule in the warning above is for products made from ground meat, not for a whole piece of bacon.

According to an Oregon State University Extension guide, cured bacon must be cooked or hot-smoked, in a smoker-grill or in an oven set above 160 °F, until the inside of the bacon reaches that same temperature, about 71 °C.
Without a checked source, JarAtlas cannot say how long it keeps, even in the refrigerator.
JarAtlas has found no tested home recipe for bacon cooked in onion skins from a checked source.
